findings.problem: The root README makes reading the large experiment index the second routine step and calls it the practical routing layer, whereas the current route and working guide prescribe bounded research-memory retrieval and lookup pointers.
findings.proposed_fix: Replace the routine order with: read current route; use ideas search/show for history and priorities for concrete semantic propositions; use lookup GDTNNN and the named primary report. Keep the experiment index links as optional browsing resources.
findings.not_required: Do not remove or rewrite the legacy index.

findings.problem: The workflow entry section describes only the heterogeneous ideas/history commands; it never exposes priorities as the ordinary concrete semantic view. Those commands remain valid, but a reader following only this guide can land in the old mixed view.
findings.proposed_fix: Add a short distinction after the start instructions: priorities QUERY is the semantic proposition view; --show ID --field cases/evidence opens full scope; --shortlist is the separately reviewed conditional subset. Keep ideas search/show for historic experiment and reopening dossiers.
